title: Thai Chicken
description: Breast chicken in a ginger, chilli and cream sauce. Warmth without the fire — a nod to Thai flavours in a classic bistro setting.

ingredients.notes: Don't add too much all at once — you can't take it out once it's in.

method.instruction: Melt half the butter in a frying pan over medium-high heat. Pan-fry chicken breast for 3–4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and rest on a warm plate.
In the same pan, add remaining butter. Add diced onion and grated ginger and cook until softened and fragrant, about 2–3 minutes.
Add fresh chilli and cook briefly for 30 seconds until aromatic.
Pour in thickened cream and reduce for 2–3 minutes until the sauce coats the back of a spoon. Season with salt.
Plate the chicken and spoon the ginger-chilli cream sauce generously over the top.

notes.title: Fresh Chilli and Ginger
notes.content: This dish uses fresh red chilli and fresh grated ginger — not dried, paste, or sambal. The heat is mild and aromatic rather than fiery, letting the cream carry the warmth. No demi glace is used.
